tags.description: The list of tags to organize this site into.

description.description: This is a description of a reportingUnit

resolution.description: The desired resolution of the outputs. Valid options are 30 and 10 (meters).

periodChangeStartYear.description: The start of the period of interest

periodChangeEndYear.description: The end of the period of interest (inclusive)

forest.description: Whether or not to generate forest change layers in the analysis.

forestBaselineYear.description: The year of the forest baseline (periodChangeStartYear will be used if not provided)

controlBoundaryPath.description: control boundary path, only valid for initial creation.

mangrove.description: Whether or not to use the mangrove model for in the analysis. Defaults to false.
